title: Alpine bird community, Valais (CH): early breeding season

study.project_description: 15 recorders in 2 sites of swiss alps

habitat.description: South faced Alpine grassland, above treeline

analysis.selection_rule: least effort with richness >= target (% of best candidate); ties: highest richness

temporal.description: Schedule selected on this pilot (90% target) applied to other days of the same season, same recorders

spatial.description: Schedules selected on subsets of these recorders (same 7 days) and applied to the other recorders

validation.guidance: Transfers well within the same season phase and between these two Alpine sites; not to single recorders or to late summer (69-83% from late July).

notes: Reference preset from Serrurier et al. (JAV, in revision); same settings as in the paper.
